name: bruno
description: BRUNO - a realtime multiplayer card game (UNO with superpowers)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bruno/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bruno/server && npm run typecheck -w @bruno/client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @bruno/shared && npm run test -w @bruno/server
